title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Transfer Learning for Plant Leaf Classification: Code and Reproduction Artifacts
description: Code and CSV metrics for hybrid quantum-classical transfer learning (frozen ImageNet ResNet18 with a PennyLane dressed VQC head) on PlantVillage leaf subsets, plus classical and head-matched baselines. PlantVillage images are not redistributed.
